plugins.name: engagement-os
plugins.description: Composable operating system for consulting engagements. Pursuit: rfp-analyze → bid-research → bid-respond. Delivery: scaffold → ingest → canonicalize → findings → validate → build, with a panel review gate. Scaffold only the blocks you need (research / pursuit / delivery / full); source material is bucketed by confidentiality constraint. 11 skills + 6 playbook commands + templates + scripts.
